subject: Orderset MSA & Order Form intake — party reconciliation and first-pass redlines
messages:
From: Lena Garcia <lena@orderset.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orderset MSA + Order Form — initial package

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Attached are the redline-ready documents from our side: Orderset_MSA_v1.docx and Orderset_OrderForm.xlsx. To get the kickoff moving, we need a few clarifications from Redwood before we start drafting counter-redlines: 

- Confirm the legal entity that will be signing (bill-to and contracting entity).
- Confirm standard data residency requirement (we currently require EU residency for certain customers; for this account they asked US-only).
- Confirm the intended start date and pilot metrics we should reference on the Order Form.
- Any required SOC 2 / penetration test evidence or specific security questionnaire we should complete?

High-level asks from Orderset: keep IP assignment language as-is (they prefer customer data remains with the customer, vendor retains model improvements language), 30-day data deletion option after termination, and a $5M liability cap. If Redwood has standard counters on IP/derivative rights, please let us know early.

We'd like to close commercial terms and get an executable by end of month. Can your team do a first-pass redline and call out any non-starter clauses?

Attachments: Orderset_MSA_v1.docx (docx), Orderset_OrderForm.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks —
Lena Garcia
Head of Legal Ops | Orderset, Inc.
lena@orderset.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lena Garcia <lena@orderset.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orderset MSA + Order Form — initial package

Thanks, Lena — and appreciated the clear package. Looping in Legal (Marissa), Contracts (Jonas) and Sales (Ben) to coordinate.

Quick plan / asks from our side to keep things moving:

- Marissa/Jonas: can you do a first-pass redline focused on: signatory entity + billing, IP/derivative language, data residency & deletion, indemnity/limit language, and any standard Redwood baseline clauses (SLA, data handling exhibit)? Target EOD 2026-08-06 for comments so commercial can assess.
- Ben: will confirm target start date and pilot metrics with the customer by 12:00 PT today and confirm billing entity.
- Lena: can you confirm who the signing authority will be (name/title) and whether Orderset wants a separate DPA exhibit or prefer inline language? Also confirm whether 30-day deletion is a hard requirement or negotiable.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- 8/06 EOD: Redwood first-pass redlines
- 8/07 AM: commercial alignment on price/exhibits
- 8/10: mutual review call if needed; aim to have counterparty feedback by 8/12

Marissa — please note our typical playbook: we try to preserve customer data ownership, provide limited vendor rights for model improvement under a narrow clause, and push to carve out production data from IP assignment. If you identify any non-negotiable Orderset language, flag with "non-starter" in the redline.

Thanks all —
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lena Garcia <lena@orderset.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orderset MSA + Order Form — initial package

On Tue, Aug 5, 2026 at 11:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Lena — and appreciated the clear package. Looping in Legal (Marissa), Contracts (Jonas) and Sales (Ben) to coordinate.

Thanks — I reviewed the attachments quickly and will do a focused first-pass. Key items I will call out up-front so Commercial can prepare negotiation points: 

1) IP / Model Improvements — Orderset asks to keep IP with customer. We will propose a limited "Model Improvement" license to Redwood for aggregated, de-identified improvements only, and explicitly exclude customer production prompts and outputs. If Orderset insists on full assignment of derivative rights, we'll treat as high priority escalation.

2) Data retention / deletion — Orderset requested 30-day deletion. We need to confirm technical feasibility with Ops, but we can accept a 30-day deletion for ephemeral logs and non-critical metadata; longer retention may be required for fraud/debugging for pilot (flagged).

3) Liability cap — Orderset requested $5M. Redwood standard is $10M for this tier; if commercial wants to move to $5M we should get a documented rationale/credit request.

4) Security evidence — please provide current SOC 2 report and a contact for security review. I will attach a short evidence checklist to the redline PDF so the customer sees actionable asks.

I'll produce two artifacts by EOD 8/06: (a) a tracked PDF summary with top-line issues (Redline_MSA_comments.pdf), and (b) a plain-text Order Form change log (OrderForm_changes.txt) with suggested fill values for the billing entity and start date. If we need to escalate IP or indemnity, I'll highlight language to Karthik for leadership review.

Attachments: Redline_MSA_comments.pdf (summary, tracked), OrderForm_changes.txt (changeset)

-Marissa
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Lena Garcia <lena@orderset.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orderset MSA + Order Form — initial package

Thanks — quick updates from our side: 

- Bill-to / contracting entity: Orderset, Inc. (legal entity registered in CA).
- Signing authority for this deal: Marco Ruiz, Chief Legal Officer (will provide a signer authorization PDF attached).
- 30-day deletion is a preference but we can be flexible for pilot scope if there's a documented technical need; we'll confirm specific retention windows after Ops review.
- SOC 2: we can share the most recent report; I'll have our security ops send over a copy to Jonas by EOD.

I can do a 15-minute sync tomorrow to walk through the redline highlights. Proposed times: 9:00 AM PT or 2:30 PM PT. Calendly (if easier): https://calendly.com/orderset/15min

Attachments: Supplier_Signer_Authority.pdf

Best —
Lena
